acceptance: Preregister multiple project domains, prolonged sessions and natural user follow-ups with matched model/settings and explicit handling of host trust.
Use independent reviewed intent, duplicate-effort and final-code scoring; preserve all failures and source artifacts.

payload.description: Preserve the unfinished field-study direction from DIP-L07 after closing its executed matched pilot. Existing controlled studies showed equal measured quality and higher management cost. Do not treat the broader quality hypothesis as proven.
payload.title: Evaluate DIP quality in naturalistic multi-domain and multi-day workflows
